audience.text: Python developers building applications that process PDF documents, including those needing document creation, conversion, text extraction, form handling, and compliance checks.

capabilities.text: Create new PDFs or load existing ones from files, bytes, or streams; add, remove, and reorder pages; and modify page properties.
capabilities.title: Create and Edit PDF Documents

capabilities.text: Extract text with region and artifact filtering, search and replace text, redact content, and auto-link URLs and email addresses.
capabilities.title: Text Extraction and Editing

capabilities.text: Extract tables from PDFs as structured data, export them to CSV, and create new tables with headers, styling, and column spans.
capabilities.title: Table Extraction and Authoring

capabilities.text: Render pages to images (PNG, TIFF, JPEG, WebP), export to SVG with selectable text, and generate contact sheets.
capabilities.title: Rendering and Export

capabilities.text: Add, edit, and remove annotations; handle form fields, validation, and flattening; and exchange annotations in JSON or XFDF.
capabilities.title: Annotations and Forms

capabilities.text: Encrypt and decrypt PDFs, sign documents with PAdES support, validate PDF/A, PDF/UA, and PDF/X compliance, and sanitize documents.
capabilities.title: Security and Compliance

capabilities.text: Inspect document fonts, embed missing fonts from system or custom sources, and substitute fonts for rendering.
capabilities.title: Font Management

capabilities.text: Use the low-code plugin layer for common batch operations like merging, splitting, optimizing, and converting documents.
capabilities.title: Batch and Low-Code Workflows

limitations.text: Page rendering is a best-effort rasterizer, not a certification-grade visual engine; overprint support is a composite RGB preview.
PDF/A and PDF/UA validation are heuristic checks; formal certification requires a dedicated validator like veraPDF.
OCR and layout reflow are not implemented; text replacement and redaction rewrite matched runs in place without reflow.
SVG export writes polylines rather than curves and text as glyph outlines, which renders exactly but is not selectable.
WOFF2 decoding and complex-text shaping each need an optional extra; without them these paths fall back to file-name metadata or fail explicitly.
The bundled JPEG 2000 decoder is pure Python and slow; install the images extra for anything larger than a thumbnail.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic PDF creation, editing, and conversion without requiring a GUI or external tools.
Supports text extraction, replacement, redaction, and search with context and region filtering.
Provides rendering to images (PNG, TIFF, JPEG, WebP), SVG export, and contact sheet generation.
Enables PDF/A, PDF/UA, and PDF/X compliance checks and conversion, along with font embedding and substitution.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Python is an open-source, MIT-licensed Python library for creating, reading, editing, rendering, and validating PDF documents, targeting Python 3.11+.

workflows.name: Create and Save PDF
workflows.text: Create a new PDF document, add a page with text, and save it to a file using the Document class.

workflows.name: Load and Inspect PDF
workflows.text: Load an existing PDF from a file path, inspect its page count, version, and metadata, then close it.

workflows.name: Extract Tables to CSV
workflows.text: Extract tables from specific pages, convert them to lists or CSV, and save them to files.

workflows.name: Export to HTML or Markdown
workflows.text: Convert a PDF document to HTML or Markdown format, optionally splitting into pages and managing resources.

workflows.name: Add Table of Contents
workflows.text: Generate a table of contents from bookmarks or headings and insert it at a specified page position.

workflows.name: Sanitize PDF
workflows.text: Remove metadata, scripts, attachments, comments, and hidden layers from a PDF in one pass.
